name: slash_guard_seconds
notes: Slash - Guard: how long the armor lasts, restarted by every enemy hit. The sheet (crusader_skill_values.csv) states 5% armor for each enemy hit and at most 5 stacks and no length, and Power/X1_Crusader_Slash.pow has none either (SF_15, SF_16); the designer answered 3 seconds, the same as Zeal (card q-1021-01)

name: slash_carve_radius_yards
notes: Slash - Carve: how far in front the larger area reaches (Power/X1_Crusader_Slash.pow SF_13 'D: Width' = 8.75; the skill's own reach is 6, skill_targeting.csv). The sheet says only 'a larger area'. The core's cone takes the enemies it takes; the module strikes the enemies of this reach it did not take

name: slash_carve_arc_degrees
notes: Slash - Carve: the arc in front of the Crusader the larger area strikes in. Power/X1_Crusader_Slash.pow gives Carve a capsule with 'D: Depth' 0 and an offset of 2.5 (SF_11, SF_12) and no angle; the designer answered 120 degrees, the DiIiS reading (card q-1021-02). The plain skill keeps the core's own 90 degree cone

name: smite_shared_fate_seconds
notes: Smite - Shared Fate: how long the enemies the chains bound stay bound, so how long moving apart can still stun them. The sheet states the stun and the distance and no length; Power/X1_Crusader_Smite.pow SF_33 'A: Eligible Duration' = 5.0

name: smite_shared_fate_check_seconds
notes: PLACEHOLDER for the designer. Smite - Shared Fate: how often the module looks at the bound enemies to see if a pair has moved apart. D3 checks every frame and the sheets state no interval, so there is no sourced number. Blank: the module looks every 0.05 seconds, the code's floor against 0 (dc_crusader_smite.cpp CheckFloorSeconds); a longer interval catches a stun later and costs less

name: smite_shatter_delay_seconds
notes: Smite - Shatter: how long after the chains strike an enemy it explodes. The sheet says only that the chains explode; Power/X1_Crusader_Smite.pow SF_10 'c: Expiration Delay' = 0.5. 0 explodes at once

name: justice_crack_radius_yards
notes: Justice - Crack: how far around the enemy hit the smaller hammers look for enemies to fly to. The sheet says the hammer cracks into smaller hammers that fly out; Power/X1_Crusader_Justice.pow SF_2 'B: Target Area Radius' = 40

name: justice_holy_bolt_radius_yards
notes: Justice - Holy Bolt: how far from the Crusader an ally can be and still be healed. The sheet says 'you and your allies'; Power/X1_Crusader_Justice.pow SF_19 'E: Heal Radius' = 60

name: shield_bash_stop_yards
notes: Shield Bash: how far short of the enemy the charge stops. Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldBash2.pow SF_35 'Stop At Target Distance' = 4.0. The charge is a move to that place (as the Monk's dashes), not a run

name: shield_bash_area_yards
notes: Shield Bash: how far the bash reaches (the sheet says 'all nearby foes' and gives no yards). Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldBash2.pow SF_1 'Total: Radius' = 17, skill_targeting.csv

name: shield_bash_arc_degrees
notes: Shield Bash: the width of the cone along the line to the enemy aimed at, in which the bash hits the other enemies. Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldBash2.pow SF_2 'Total: Angle' = 30

name: shield_bash_pound_arc_degrees
notes: Shield Bash - Pound: the cone's width with the rune (its reach is the sheet's 8 yards). Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldBash2.pow SF_31 'D: Target Area Modifier' = 5

name: shield_bash_fragment_extra_yards
notes: Shield Bash - Shattered Shield: how far past the bash's reach the fragments hit more enemies. Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldBash2.pow SF_18 'B: Second Target Radius' = SF_1 + 10

name: shield_bash_fragment_extra_degrees
notes: Shield Bash - Shattered Shield: how much wider than the bash's cone the fragments reach. Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldBash2.pow SF_19 'B: Second Target Angle' = SF_2 + 30

name: shield_bash_cross_length_yards
notes: Shield Bash - Shield Cross: how far each of the four additional shields reaches from the Crusader. The sheet and the power file's formulas state no length; the designer answered 20 yards (card q-1021-05)

name: shield_bash_cross_width_yards
notes: Shield Bash - Shield Cross: how wide each additional shield hits. The sheet and the power file's formulas state no width; the designer answered 5 yards (card q-1021-06)

name: shield_bash_knockback_yards
notes: Shield Bash - One on One: how far the other enemies hit are knocked back. The sheet says only 'knocked back'; the power file has a magnitude 24 and a height 3 (SF_32, SF_33) in no unit the module uses; the designer answered 5 yards (card q-1021-07)

name: sweep_attack_arc_degrees
notes: Sweep Attack: the width of the half circle in front of the Crusader in which the sweep hits (Power/X1_Crusader_SweepAttack.pow SF_27 'Base Target Pie Angle' = 180, skill_targeting.csv row Sweep Attack). The core's own cone is narrower, so the module strikes the enemies of this arc that the cone did not take

name: sweep_attack_pull_yards
notes: Sweep Attack - Gathering Sweep: how far in front of the Crusader the enemies caught are pulled to. Power/X1_Crusader_SweepAttack.pow SF_25 'A: knockback offset MIN' = 1 (SF_18 adds a delta of 1 more, a range the module does not roll: the minimum is built)

name: sweep_attack_burn_tick_seconds
notes: Sweep Attack - Blazing Sweep: the interval between the ticks of the fire: 4 hits of 30% over the 2 seconds. The sheet gives the total (120% weapon damage) and the 2 seconds and the power file's formulas no tick length (SF_5, SF_17); the designer answered 0.5 seconds (card q-1021-08)

name: blessed_hammer_pool_radius_yards
notes: Blessed Hammer - Burning Wrath: how far from the middle of a fire pool an enemy still burns. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedHammer.pow SF_7 'A: Fire Pool Target Radius' = 8

name: blessed_hammer_pool_seconds
notes: Blessed Hammer - Burning Wrath: how long a fire pool burns. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedHammer.pow SF_13 'A: Pool Duration' = 2

name: blessed_hammer_pool_tick_seconds
notes: Blessed Hammer - Burning Wrath: the interval between a pool's ticks. The sheet says the pool deals its damage 'per second'

name: blessed_hammer_pools_at_once
notes: Blessed Hammer - Burning Wrath: the most pools one Crusader has burning at a time. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedHammer.pow SF_14 'A: Max # Pools at a time' = 4

name: blessed_hammer_slow_pct
notes: Blessed Hammer - Brute Force: how much the hammer slows the enemies it hits. The sheet says 'Slows enemies it passes through' and gives no percentage; the designer answered 60% for 2 seconds (card q-1021-11)

name: blessed_hammer_slow_seconds
notes: Blessed Hammer - Brute Force: how long that slow lasts. No source states it; the designer answered 2 seconds (card q-1021-11)

name: blessed_hammer_seconds
notes: Blessed Hammer: how long the hammer spins before it is gone. The sheet says it spins around you and no source states its life; the designer answered 3 seconds (card q-1021-10), a number he tunes in game

name: blessed_hammer_reach_yards
notes: Blessed Hammer: how far from the Crusader the hammer's spiral ends, the radius it grows to over its life. The designer answered 15 yards (card q-1021-10), a number he tunes in game

name: blessed_hammer_loops
notes: Blessed Hammer: how many times round the Crusader the hammer goes over its life, in loops. The designer answered about 1.5 (card q-1021-10), a number he tunes in game

name: blessed_hammer_hit_radius_yards
notes: Blessed Hammer: how near the hammer must be to an enemy to hit it, and how wide Thunderstruck's arcs are. The hammer's size is in no source (the sheet, the power file's formulas); the designer answered 5 yards (card q-1021-13)

name: blessed_hammer_step_seconds
notes: Blessed Hammer: how often the module looks where the hammer is and whom it touches, and how often Thunderstruck may arc. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedHammer.pow SF_16 'B: Tickrate' = 0.1

name: blessed_hammer_arc_chance_pct
notes: Blessed Hammer - Thunderstruck: the chance, at each look, of an arc between the Crusader and the hammer ('occasionally'). Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedHammer.pow SF_33 'B: Lightning Chance' = 0.3

name: blessed_hammer_limitless_life_factor
notes: Blessed Hammer - Limitless: how much longer the hammer lasts with the rune. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedHammer.pow SF_38 'C: Increased Lifetime' = 1.5; the sheet states only the larger area

name: blessed_shield_bounce_yards
notes: Blessed Shield: how far from the enemy it hit the shield looks for the next enemy to ricochet to, and where Shattering Throw's fragments find theirs. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedShield.pow SF_13 'Target Bounce Radius' = 20, skill_targeting.csv

name: blessed_shield_range_yards
notes: Blessed Shield - Piercing Shield: how far down its line the shield pierces. Power/X1_Crusader_BlessedShield.pow SF_0 'Max Range' = 70, skill_targeting.csv

name: blessed_shield_pierce_width_yards
notes: Blessed Shield - Piercing Shield: how wide the line is along which the shield pierces enemies. The sheet says it 'pierces through all enemies' and the power file's formulas give no width; the designer answered 3 yards (card q-1021-15)

name: blessed_shield_knockaside_yards
notes: Blessed Shield - Piercing Shield: how far an enemy it knocks aside is moved (away from the Crusader). The sheet says 'knock them aside'; the power file has a magnitude of 10 (SF_25) in no unit the module uses; the designer answered 3 yards (card q-1021-16)

name: fist_bolt_travel_yards
notes: Fist of the Heavens: how far each of the explosion's bolts flies. Power/X1_Crusader_FistOfTheHeavens.pow SF_8 'Total: Projectile Travel Distance' = 85

name: fist_bolt_width_yards
notes: Fist of the Heavens: how wide the lane of a bolt is, and of Retribution's fist and Fissure's arcs: an enemy within half of it of the line is struck. The sheet says the bolts pierce and arc outward and no source gives a width; the designer answered 3 yards for all of them (card q-1021-14)

name: fist_tempest_tick_seconds
notes: Fist of the Heavens - Heaven's Tempest: the interval between the storm's ticks. Power/X1_Crusader_FistOfTheHeavens.pow SF_14 'A: Refresh Interval' = 1 (the sheet says 'every second')

name: fist_fissure_radius_yards
notes: Fist of the Heavens - Fissure: how far from the fissure an enemy still burns. Power/X1_Crusader_FistOfTheHeavens.pow SF_31 'C: Target Radius around cloud' = 8

name: fist_fissure_tick_seconds
notes: Fist of the Heavens - Fissure: the interval between the fissure's ticks and its arcs. Power/X1_Crusader_FistOfTheHeavens.pow SF_21 'C: Test/Damage frequency' = 0.5

name: fist_fissure_arc_yards
notes: Fist of the Heavens - Fissure: how near another fissure must be for lightning to arc between them. Power/X1_Crusader_FistOfTheHeavens.pow SF_32 'C: Target Radius between tesla' = 6

name: fist_knockback_yards
notes: Fist of the Heavens - Reverberation: how far the shockwave knocks an enemy away. The sheet says 'knocked away'; the power file has a magnitude of 20 (SF_16) in no unit the module uses; the designer answered 5 yards (card q-1021-17)

name: shield_glare_arc_degrees
notes: Shield Glare: how wide the glare's cone is. data/d3/skill_targeting.csv for Shield Glare cites Power/X1_Crusader_ShieldGlare.pow 'Beam Damage Cone Radius 30 and Angle 120' (SF_0, SF_3); the core's cone for the cast is narrower, so the module blinds the enemies of the rest of this arc as well

name: consecration_tick_seconds
notes: Consecration: the interval between the ground's heal and its per-second effects (Bed of Nails, Shattered Ground, Fearful). The sheets say 'Life per second', 'every second' and 'per second', so one second

name: consecration_barrier_check_seconds
notes: Consecration - Aegis Purgatory: how often the module looks at the enemies near the edge to put back one that has crossed it. D3 blocks movement every frame and the sheets state no interval; the designer set 0.25 seconds (q-1021-21). The code never looks more often than every 0.1 seconds (dc_crusader_consecration.cpp CheckFloorSeconds, a guard against 0); a shorter interval lets fewer enemies slip a yard through and costs more

name: judgment_penitence_tick_seconds
notes: Judgment - Penitence: the interval between the heals (the rune's tooltip says the Crusader heals for Life per second, for the rune's seconds): the sheets say 'per second', so one second

name: steed_charge_tick_seconds
notes: Steed Charge: the interval of the ride's ticks, and so of the damage of Spiked Barding and Draw and Quarter and of the Life of Rejuvenation, which pays its whole heal in this many ticks (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_5 'A: Damage Tick Interval' = 1 / SF_6 'A: Damage Tick Rate Multiplier' = 1 / 4). Each tick deals the sheet's per-second number times this

name: steed_charge_movement_speed_bonus
notes: Steed Charge: the ride's movement speed bonus (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_1 'Movement Speed Bonus' = 1.5), read as +150% movement speed for the whole ride. The sheets state no speed (the tooltip only says 'ride through enemies unhindered'), so the reading is the power file's alone

name: steed_charge_spiked_barding_radius_yards
notes: Steed Charge - Spiked Barding: how far from the Crusader an enemy is struck as the horse rides through it (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_12 'A: Damage Capsule Radius' = 6.5; the capsule's length SF_7 = 4.5 is not used, the module strikes a circle round the Crusader)

name: steed_charge_nightmare_pool_radius_yards
notes: Steed Charge - Nightmare: the radius of each pool of fire the horse leaves (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_23 'D: Fire Pool Damage Radius' = 6.0)

name: steed_charge_nightmare_pool_seconds
notes: Steed Charge - Nightmare: how long each pool of fire burns (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_24 'D: Fire Pool Duration' = 1.4)

name: steed_charge_nightmare_pool_tick_seconds
notes: Steed Charge - Nightmare: the interval of a pool's damage; each tick deals the sheet's 550% for a second times this (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_21 'D: Fire Pool Interval' = 0.2, read as the pool's tick)

name: steed_charge_nightmare_pool_spacing_yards
notes: Steed Charge - Nightmare: how far the horse goes before it leaves the next pool (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_26 'D: Fire Pool Required Distance To Drop Next Squared' = 10, so the square root of 10 yards); the module looks once a ride tick. SF_25 'Fire Pool Max Num' = 8 is not needed: a pool lasts 1.4 seconds and a ride tick is 0.25, so at most six burn at once

name: steed_charge_draw_radius_yards
notes: Steed Charge - Draw and Quarter: how far from the Crusader an enemy can be and still be bound (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_28 'E: Herd Radius' = 15.0); the sheet's target_count of them, the nearest, are bound at the cast

name: steed_charge_draw_distance_yards
notes: Steed Charge - Draw and Quarter: the distance at which a bound enemy trails the Crusader (Power/X1_Crusader_SteedCharge.pow SF_33 'E: Min Distance From Player To Drag' = 10.0): one farther is drawn in to it each tick, one nearer stays where it is

name: condemn_vacuum_interval_seconds
notes: Condemn - Vacuum: how often it sucks enemies in while the explosion builds (Power/X1_Crusader_Condemn.pow SF_11 'B: Suck in interval' = 0.5); the pulses that fit the build time, the first one an interval in

name: condemn_vacuum_radius_step_yards
notes: Condemn - Vacuum: how much farther each pulse reaches than the one before it, from the explosion's own radius (Power/X1_Crusader_Condemn.pow SF_17 'B: Target Radius Add Each Time' = 2.5, SF_16 'Target Radius Start' = the explosion radius). The first pulse reaches the radius plus one step, because it takes only enemies beyond the explosion (SF_21 'Min Distance to Suck in' = the explosion radius): a first pulse at the radius alone would take none

name: condemn_vacuum_max_targets
notes: Condemn - Vacuum: the most enemies one pulse draws in, the nearest first (Power/X1_Crusader_Condemn.pow SF_18 'B: Max #Targets sucked in' = 10)

name: condemn_vacuum_offset_min_yards
notes: Condemn - Vacuum: the nearest an enemy is drawn to the Crusader (Power/X1_Crusader_Condemn.pow SF_19 'B: knockback offset MIN' = 2); the draw sets it down that far from the Crusader plus a random part of the extra below

name: condemn_vacuum_offset_extra_yards
notes: Condemn - Vacuum: the most added at random to the nearest distance an enemy is drawn to (Power/X1_Crusader_Condemn.pow SF_20 'B: knockback offset DELTA' = 1)

name: phalanx_charge_distance_yards
notes: Phalanx: the farthest the avatars run from the Crusader, however far the target point is (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_1 'Max Distance' = 60; skill_targeting.csv range 60)

name: phalanx_charge_speed_yards_per_second
notes: Phalanx: how fast the avatars run to the target point. The power file gives a speed of 0.4 (SF_13) and no unit; the d3planner Crusader simulator moves them 0.4 yards a frame at 60 frames a second, 24 yards a second (card q-1021-25, closed from that source; the unit is inferred from the simulator's convention). Shield Charge and Stampede run faster in the ratio of the speeds below

name: phalanx_charge_speed_base
notes: Phalanx: the power file's base speed (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_13 'Base: Speed' = 0.4); only its ratio to the runes' speeds below is used, so Shield Charge runs (0.4 + 0.2) / 0.4 times and Stampede (0.4 + 0.3) / 0.4 times as fast as the plain charge

name: phalanx_shield_charge_speed_bonus
notes: Phalanx - Shield Charge: what its charge adds to the base speed (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_12 'B: Speed Modifier' = 0.2)

name: phalanx_stampede_speed_bonus
notes: Phalanx - Stampede: what its charge adds to the base speed (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_43 'C: Speed Modifier' = 0.3)

name: phalanx_shield_charge_bash_radius_yards
notes: Phalanx - Shield Charge: the radius of the bash where the avatars arrive (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_21 'B: Bash Radius' = 12; SF_22 'B: Bash Angle' = 22 degrees is not used: the module strikes the whole circle)

name: phalanx_bowmen_fire_seconds
notes: Phalanx - Bowmen: how often each bowman shoots (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_7 'A: Fire Rate' = 0.6); each shot deals the sheet's damage

name: phalanx_shield_bearers_seconds
notes: Phalanx - Shield Bearers: how long the avatars stand at the target point (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_28 'D: Duration' = 5); the sheet states no duration

name: phalanx_shield_bearers_radius_yards
notes: Phalanx - Shield Bearers: the radius of the place they hold, which no enemy crosses (Power/x1_Crusader_Phalanx3.pow SF_33 'D: Target Area Radius' = 5)

name: phalanx_shield_bearers_check_seconds
notes: Phalanx - Shield Bearers: how often the module looks at the enemies near the place they hold to put back one that has crossed it. D3 blocks movement every frame and no D3 source holds an interval; the standing default for a check with no sourced number is 0.25 seconds (card q-1021-26 closed by it, as Consecration's Aegis Purgatory). The code never looks more often than every 0.1 seconds (dc_crusader_phalanx.cpp CheckFloorSeconds); a shorter interval lets fewer enemies slip a yard through and costs more

name: laws_pulse_seconds
notes: The Laws (Valor, Justice, Hope): how often a Law's aura hands its number to the Crusader and the group within its radius. The sheets state each Law's numbers and a 60 yard reach and no D3 source holds an interval; the standing default for an aura with no sourced number is a pulse every 1 second (card q-1021-27, the value already built, filled as final). A number a pulse gives lasts the pulse and a quarter second more, so a longer interval is a coarser aura and a shorter one costs more sheet updates

name: falling_sword_superheated_tick_seconds
notes: Falling Sword - Superheated: how often the burning ground strikes the enemies on it (Power/X1_Crusader_FallingSword.pow SF_12 'A: refresh rate' = 0.3); the sheet's 310% weapon damage a second is paid in ticks of this length

name: falling_sword_superheated_radius_yards
notes: Falling Sword - Superheated: the radius of the burning ground (Power/X1_Crusader_FallingSword.pow SF_17 'A: radius' = 14, the same as the landing's)

name: falling_sword_part_the_clouds_strike_seconds
notes: Falling Sword - Part the Clouds: how often the storm strikes one random enemy under it (Power/X1_Crusader_FallingSword.pow SF_20 'B: refresh rate' = 0.8); the sheet states no interval

name: falling_sword_part_the_clouds_radius_yards
notes: Falling Sword - Part the Clouds: how far from the landing the storm reaches, and so which enemies it may strike (Power/X1_Crusader_FallingSword.pow SF_22 'B: radius' = 24); the sheet says 'the area you land on'

name: falling_sword_flurry_tick_seconds
notes: Falling Sword - Flurry: how often the swords strike the enemies in the flurry (Power/X1_Crusader_FallingSword.pow SF_43 'E: Tick Rate' = 0.25); the sheet's 230% weapon damage is read as a rate a second, paid in ticks of this length

name: falling_sword_flurry_radius_yards
notes: Falling Sword - Flurry: the radius of the flurry, which strikes and incapacitates the enemies in it (Power/X1_Crusader_FallingSword.pow SF_42 'E: Radius' = 15)

name: akarats_champion_fire_starter_tick_seconds
notes: Akarat's Champion - Fire Starter: the interval between the ticks of the burn (the sheet's 460% weapon damage over 3 seconds): 6 ticks of 460/6 percent. The sheet and Power/X1_Crusader_AkaratsChampion.pow state no tick length (SF_6 'Fire Damage Tick-Interval' = 0.2 belongs to the fire pools of the rune's earlier form); the d3planner Crusader simulator ticks the burn six times over the 3 seconds (card q-1021-29, closed from that source)

name: akarats_champion_fire_starter_icd_factor
notes: Akarat's Champion - Fire Starter: the gap before the same enemy burns again is this over the Crusader's attacks a second (Power/X1_Crusader_AkaratsChampion.pow SF_40 'A: DoT Application ICD' = 0.9 / Attacks_Per_Second_Total)

name: heavens_fury_tick_seconds
notes: Heaven's Fury: the interval between the ticks of the ray, of Blessed Ground and of Split Fury's beams. The power file gives their damage as a rate a second (Power/X1_Crusader_HeavensFury3.pow SF_1 2.85, SF_6 3.1, SF_11 3.3, SF_20 4.61) and no tick length, and the sheets say 'over 6 seconds'; paid in seconds, a reading, as Consecration's per-second effects are

name: heavens_fury_split_beam_radius_yards
notes: Heaven's Fury - Split Fury: the radius of each of the smaller beams (Power/X1_Crusader_HeavensFury3.pow SF_21 'C: Radius' = 4); the sheet gives no radius

name: heavens_fury_fires_distance_yards
notes: Heaven's Fury - Fires of Heaven: how far the beam through the Crusader reaches (Power/X1_Crusader_HeavensFury3.pow SF_14 'E: Max Distance' = 55)

name: heavens_fury_fires_radius_yards
notes: Heaven's Fury - Fires of Heaven: how far to each side of the beam's line an enemy is still struck (Power/X1_Crusader_HeavensFury3.pow SF_15 'E: Beam radius' = 3)

name: heavens_fury_barrier_check_seconds
notes: Heaven's Fury - Thou Shalt Not Pass: how often the module looks at the enemies near the edge of the ground to put back one that has crossed it. D3 blocks movement every frame and no D3 source holds an interval; the standing default for a check with no sourced number is 0.25 seconds (card q-1021-30 closed by it, as Consecration's Aegis Purgatory). The code never looks more often than every 0.1 seconds (dc_crusader_hold.cpp CheckFloorSeconds); a shorter interval lets fewer enemies slip a yard through and costs more

name: bombardment_search_radius_yards
notes: Bombardment: how far from the aimed point the spheres look for the enemy they fall on (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_13 'Search radius' = 35); the sheet says 'enemies around you'

name: bombardment_first_delay_seconds
notes: Bombardment: the wait before the first sphere leaves (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_4 'Spawn Rate Delay' = 0.35)

name: bombardment_impact_delay_seconds
notes: Bombardment: how long a sphere takes from leaving to its impact (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_14 'Impact Delay' = 0.55)

name: bombardment_spawn_wait_seconds
notes: Bombardment: the least wait before the next sphere leaves (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_7 'Base: Spawn Rate Wait Min Time' = 0.55)

name: bombardment_spawn_wait_extra_seconds
notes: Bombardment: the most that is added at random to the least wait before the next sphere (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_39 'Base: Spawn Rate Wait Delta Time' = 1.5)

name: bombardment_barrels_wait_added_seconds
notes: Bombardment - Barrels of Spikes: what the rune adds to the least wait (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_18 'A: Spawn Rate Modifier Min' = 0.1)

name: bombardment_mine_field_wait_added_seconds
notes: Bombardment - Mine Field: what the rune adds to the least wait (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_30 'C: Spawn Rate Modifier Min' = 0.5)

name: bombardment_mine_seconds
notes: Bombardment - Mine Field: how long a mine waits for an enemy (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_24 'C: Mine Lifetime' = 5)

name: bombardment_mine_min_yards
notes: Bombardment - Mine Field: the nearest to its impact a mine lies (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_29 'C: Min Mine Spawn Distance' = 5)

name: bombardment_mine_max_yards
notes: Bombardment - Mine Field: the farthest from its impact a mine lies (Power/X1_Crusader_Bombardment.pow SF_28 'C: Max Mine Spawn Distance' = 30)

name: bombardment_mine_check_seconds
notes: Bombardment - Mine Field: how often the module looks at whether an enemy has walked near a mine. D3 checks every frame and no D3 source holds an interval; the standing default for a check with no sourced number is 0.25 seconds (card q-1021-32 closed by it). The code never looks more often than every 0.1 seconds (dc_crusader_bombardment.cpp MineCheckFloorSeconds); a shorter interval catches a fast enemy sooner and costs more
